newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Generale Bank, Indosuez Lux join to manage funds.
newsitem.headline: Generale Bank, Indosuez Lux join to manage funds.

text.p: Belgium's Generale Bank and Banque Indosuez Luxembourg said on Wednesday they are setting up a joint venture in Belgium specialising in fund management.
The venture, named Fastnet Belgium, will have a capital of 50 million Belgian francs ($1.59 million), with each partner contributing 50 percent. It will start operations in April 1997.

"It is the intention of the two partners, in the long term, to develop a European network specialised in the accounting management of the collective investment undertakings from different countries," Generale Bank said.
Fastnet Belgium will calculate inventory values, keep registers of shareholders and administer the business and legal affairs of investment funds.
Generale Bank said it was among the top 15 fund managers in Europe and held a Belgian fund market share of nearly 25 percent.
